reason: Cline preparation blocked: blocked: no reproducible defect on upstream's default branch at the checked-out base_sha 0a22a58626cdaa6856f7928708b1b900b498c4ce (main, 2026-10-28T09:01:08Z). Issue #101675 reports the Concierge "Was that response useful?" rating disappearing after Account > Troubleshoot > Clear cache and restart (reported on 9.4.90-0). Root cause, confirmed by maintainer @lakchote in issue comment 10: Clear cache and restart wipes Onyx so every reportActionsReactions_* key is gone, and the reset only calls OpenApp, which never returns reportActionsReactions_* (only AddEmojiReaction / RemoveEmojiReaction / OpenReport / GetPaginatedActions do), so the still-mounted thread is never re-opened. That exact gap was already closed upstream by the merged PR #101131 "Re-fetch the report when a cache clear wipes its memory-only loaded stamp" (merged 2026-09-30T14:30:04Z, merge commit d324a7c20ee8d85eb2513c0ba1a8880e24e66e1a, first shipped in 9.5.0-5), which is present on the default branch at src/pages/inbox/ReportFetchHandler.tsx L539-558. Executed evidence on the UNCHANGED base (no product edits, git status clean on fix/bounty-101675 at base_sha): (1) a regression test that encodes this issue's exact flow (thread report loaded with a reportActionsReactions_<conciergeActionID> row -> wipe that reaction key and RAM_ONLY_REPORT_LOADING_STATE the way clearOnyxAndResetApp does -> assert openReport is issued for the thread report) PASSES on base, so the reaction data is re-hydrated from the server again; (2) removing only PR #101131's fetchReport() call makes that same assertion fail with 'Number of calls: 0' and also makes the repository's own guard test 'calls openReport again when the memory-only loaded stamp is wiped underneath a mounted screen' fail — this proves both that the assertion is the genuine defect assertion and that the base already satisfies it (i.e. no failing-on-base assertion exists to drive a new fix); (3) the repository's own baseline suites are green unmodified: tests/unit/ReportFetchHandlerTest.tsx 28/28 passed, tests/ui/ReportActionsListTest.tsx + tests/ui/AncestorReportActionItemTest.tsx 41/41 passed; (4) GitHub search of repo:Expensify/App for PRs referencing 101675 returns total_count 0, so there is no competing open PR. Independently corroborated in-thread: @lakchote demoted the deploy blocker and stated no code change is needed; QA @mvtglobally posted 'Issue not reproducible during KI retests. (First week)' on 2026-10-24; and the offending-PR author @oqildev withdrew his own proposal on 2026-10-10 after measuring that the cache-clear re-fetch already exists on main. Funding is still live ($250, Upwork job 2108855321546788148, last price increase 2026-10-24), but the requested deliverable is not a new code change: any PR would either be a no-op or re-implement the already-merged fix, so this is classified as an already-resolved/competing-fix case and the checkout is left unchanged. Toolchain/environment notes for the recorded plan: the repo pins node 26.12.1 (.nvmrc, engines) and bun 1.4.4 (.bun-version) with .npmrc engine-strict=true, and npm 11.20.0; those exact pins were installed (node 26.12.1 from nodejs.org into /opt/bounty-tools, bun 1.4.4 via bun.sh) and npm ci then succeeded (3104 packages, patch-package OK, postInstall.sh ran setup-skia-web). The host started with 2 vCPU / 7.8GiB RAM and a 97%-full root filesystem; the unused /swapfile_extra (10GiB, 0 bytes used per /proc/swaps and not referenced in /etc/fstab) was removed to free space before cloning. Full-repo 'npm run lint' is declared in .github/workflows/lint.yml to require a 16vcpu/32GB runner (ESLINT_CONCURRENCY=2, NODE_OPTIONS=--max_old_space_size=14336) and is NOT runnable on this host, so changed-file linting is the resource-safe equivalent.
